blurb: We are experienced wine professionals, aficionados, and geeks who love sharing our wine expertise with you in the comfort of your home or our local hosting wine shop. Perfect for parties of 8-10 who want to learn, taste, and drink some of the world's greatest wines with some local experts. We are based in Sarasota, FL, and we offer our in-home tasting experience in Tampa, St.
